title: MCAD deficiency
synonyms: medium chain acyl coa dehydrogenase deficiency
نقص نازعة هيدروجين أسيل CoA متوسطة السلسلة
everyday_terms: baby very sleepy when not feeding
summary: MCAD deficiency means the body cannot use certain fats for energy. This matters most when someone goes a long time without food or is ill.
inheritance_plain: It is inherited in an autosomal recessive way: a child is affected only if they get a changed copy of the ACADM gene from both parents.
carrier_meaning: A carrier has one changed copy. Carriers are healthy and usually do not know they are carriers until they are tested.
disease_meaning: A person with two changed copies has MCAD deficiency. When it is found early, for example through newborn screening, most people stay well by avoiding long gaps without food, following a plan from their specialist team.
screening: A carrier test uses a blood or saliva sample and cannot find every possible change. Some newborn screening programmes check babies for MCAD deficiency; a counsellor can tell you what is checked locally.
suggested_questions: Someone in my family has MCAD deficiency. Could I be a carrier?
Can MCAD deficiency skip a generation?
What does a test for the ACADM gene involve?
card_summary: The body can't use some fats for energy, especially when fasting or ill. Carriers are healthy.
carrier_short: One changed copy. Healthy. Can pass the copy on.
disease_short: Two changed copies. Needs a plan to avoid long gaps without food; most people stay well.
care: Specialist metabolic clinics, dietitians, genetic counselling and family support groups.
